description: This Java class 'KeyStoreUtil' provides utility methods for managing cryptographic keystores, reading and writing certificates, importing keys and certificates into keystores, and converting certificates to and from PEM format. It includes methods for handling system trust stores, component-specific keystores, and various certificate manipulations.

classes.name: KeyStoreUtil
classes.description: A utility class for handling KeyStore operations including loading, saving, certificate parsing, and key/certificate importing, mainly for SSL/TLS certificate and key management.

methods.name: storeComponentKeyStore
methods.description: Stores a component-specific keystore to the filesystem.

methods.name: getStore
methods.description: Loads a keystore from a given URL with a specified type.

methods.name: getSystemTrustStore
methods.description: Retrieves the default system trust store, either from specified system properties or default locations.

methods.name: readCertificate
methods.description: Creates an X509Certificate object from a byte array.

methods.name: getCertX500Map
methods.description: Returns a map of the subject's distinguished name components from a certificate.

methods.name: importPKCS8CertChain
methods.description: Imports a private key and certificate chain into a specified keystore entry.

methods.name: certToString
methods.description: Converts a Certificate object to its PEM string representation.

methods.name: pemToCert
methods.description: Parses a certificate from a PEM string, file, or input stream.

methods.name: pemToPkHex
methods.description: Extracts the public key from a PEM certificate and returns it as a hex string.
